method: Paired round medians; bootstrap resamples launches, then blocks within each launch.

metadata.scope: Prebaked opaque cubes; one orthographic camera; three aligned depth layers; shadows, light/reflection probes, instancing and authoring colliders disabled; no UI or scripted movement during measurement. All four modes use the same camera per scale.
metadata.timingDefinition: FrameTimingManager CPU total includes waits; GPU is native GPU frame duration. Fixed 16-record offset in 32 records sorted by timestamp. Player waits for splash completion and 3 real-time settling seconds; every mode warmup lasts at least 90 frames and 0.25 real seconds.
